name: Geometric Design of Roads
description: Introduction into highway design factors – human and vehicle factors; functional classification of roads and design requirements; highway drainage; cross sectional elements – requirements for NMT modes; road furniture, road markings, and signs; traffic calming; horizontal alignment design – curve setting and transition curves; superelevation and extra widening; gradients and vertical alignment; design of vertical curves; alignment coordination and issues; intersection – design of at grade and grade separated intersections; channelization design and principles of ramp design; bus bays, truck lay bye, and pedestrian infrastructure design; tool plaza layout and parking layout; introduction to DPR preparation.
